fields.source: Recognition Result State Matrix V1.1 and canonical Master Flow result nodes
fields.fallback: The five page states stay distinct; no default state is fabricated.
fields.error_behavior: Technical Failure remains a separate issue route.

fields.source: Normalized user image handed off from Capture; Hero Media Contract owns its mapping inside the state-specific frame.
fields.required: required for all five visual states
fields.fallback: No substitute or generated image; return to recovery/capture if unavailable.
fields.error_behavior: Missing media does not create a FishRecord.

fields.source: Pipeline top-1/candidate output plus explicit user correction per Recognition Result Behavior Spec; exact repository/API/database lineage remains C-011.
fields.required: Top-1 default for High; explicit confirmation for Medium; optional until manual selection for Low.
fields.fallback: Medium candidates stay suggestions; Low remains unconfirmed.
fields.error_behavior: Never invent an unknown species or persist an unconfirmed Low result.

fields.source: Classifier candidate output; Behavior Spec and Candidate Card Contract; C-011 field lineage is open.
fields.fallback: Do not silently select Top-1. If explicit candidates are absent, no candidate is fabricated; current failure mapping is not expanded here.
fields.error_behavior: Keep on current Result/technical recovery according to the actual pipeline outcome; no guessed state mapping.

fields.source: Current Master Flow image_quality node and 3+2 decision contract; reason-level mapping is open under C-009.
fields.error_behavior: Do not claim optical blur or distinguish blur/distance/occlusion until product/content decision.

fields.source: User-entered draft field per Metadata Input Contract; storage/API lineage remains C-011.
fields.fallback: Display the Frozen empty placeholder and preserve the prior draft.
fields.error_behavior: Invalid numeric value remains editable with field error; does not block save merely by being absent.

fields.source: User-entered draft field per Metadata Input Contract; storage/API lineage remains C-011.
fields.fallback: Display the Frozen empty placeholder and preserve the prior draft.
fields.error_behavior: Invalid numeric value remains editable with field error; does not block save merely by being absent.

fields.source: User action/selection per Metadata Input Contract; storage/API lineage remains C-011.
fields.error_behavior: Permission denial does not block save; location is requested only after an explicit action.

fields.source: User-authored memory text per Metadata Input Contract; storage/API lineage remains C-011.
fields.fallback: Empty draft with Frozen placeholder and zero counter.
fields.error_behavior: Preserve draft; cap at 300 Unicode code points; voice input is absent unless transcript capability is real.

fields.source: Explicit Result CTA; DECISION_SAVE_CATCH_NAVIGATION_V1 and Master Flow save_home node.
fields.fallback: No destination inferred from a prior unrelated flow.
fields.error_behavior: On failure remain on Result and preserve requested destination/draft for retry.

fields.source: Successful FishRecord creation; exact local/API/database mapping remains C-011.
fields.fallback: No success route without a persisted record identity.

coverage.empty: Optional metadata/story may be empty; species resolution is required before persistence for Low and explicit for Medium.
coverage.loading: Recognition presentation arrives only after the real pipeline resolves; save loading preserves layout and prevents duplicate submission.
coverage.error: No Fish/Image Quality create no record; save error stays on Result with all user fields; technical failure uses the separate issue route.
coverage.partial: Missing optional length/weight/location/story stays empty; available user data is preserved. Partial model fields are never fabricated.
coverage.network_failure: A reported save/network failure remains retryable on Result, preserves fields and requested destination, and avoids duplicate records; it is not relabeled as Image Quality.

lineage_boundary: These are product-level field names and authorities, not a claimed final mapping to Android repository/DTO, API response, database/local store, sorting or ownership. C-011 remains open.
